label: reported
text: According to the Tirana Times, police have introduced a protest‑related registry that allows administrative travel restrictions for participants even without a judicial ban. The report notes the measure expands police powers over freedom of movement.

sources.title: Anti Government Protests in Albania - Tirana Times
sources.articleText:
The Student Revolt and the Deepening Political Crisis Developments through 1 November 2026 Introduction TIRANA, 02 Nov – Albania’s student-led mobilization has become a prolonged political and institutional crisis. By November 1, the confrontation encompassed expanded police powers, freedom of movement and a reported rupture between Prime Minister Edi Rama and detained Tirana Mayor Erion Veliaj. The dispute now reaches into the governing Socialist Party, alongside unresolved demands for resignation and accountability for police violence. Two developments define the latest phase.
